'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Thomas Whaley DS Aks Moe''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Aks Moe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
